outcome: Acute cesarean delivery due to dystocia
Instrumental vaginal delivery due to dystocia
cohort: 34,261 nulliparous women in Denmark with singleton pregnancies, spontaneous onset of labor between 37 and 42 weeks gestation, and vertex fetal presentation, who gave birth between 1992 and 2010
finding: No seasonal variation in the incidence of dystocia was observed in a large cohort of Danish women.
